verdict.rationale: SigNoz is documented as free, open-source software you can self-host with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, so a local or dev instance for testing instrumentation and dashboards is a first-party option. Hands-on reports show real friction: a docker-compose stack with many services, more containers than a small app, and a failed Windows install because of sh/bash dependencies. missing for 10: a documented lightweight local/dev quickstart, Windows-friendly local setup, and corroboration that a dev instance can be used smoothly to test instrumentation and dashboards.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.
